813-2320-3563.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Flicker of Fate.
813-2320-3563.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and putting Flicker of Fate into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Flicker of Fate to your hand.
Repeat.

5742-5743-7824-8242.description:
Activate Songbird by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Songbird ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

728-3249-5004-5268.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5004-5268.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

645-1267-2719-6495.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2719-6495.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Repeat each turn.

1445-3899-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3899-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1445-4247-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4247-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2728-5662-6798-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5662-6798-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5662-6798-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 4.

625-1978-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.
625-1978-7908.description:
Cause The Notary Hobbits to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3734-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3110-3923-4050-7639.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Council of the Absolute.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

2436-7282-7340.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat.

3317-4050-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-4050-5972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3165-3532-4030-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5900-5902-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5900-5902-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

4050-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3490-4050-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4050-6752.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-2438-3817-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-2438-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4231-4659-6465.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus {1} for each time you've cast James / Follow Him from the command zone this game, plus commander tax if applicable
4231-4659-6465.description:
Cast Follow Him either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus {1} for each time you've cast James / Follow Him from the command zone this game, plus commander tax, if applicable.
Resolve Follow Him, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens and returning Follow Him to the command zone from exile.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, Food or Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 4 until you control no Clues, Foods and/or Treasures.
Cast Follow Him from the command zone using all available mana, creating a number of Clue, Food and Treasure tokens and returning Follow Him to the command zone from exile.
Repeat from step 3.
4231-4659-6465.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast James infinitely if desired. You can also activate the Clues to draw cards and/or Urza's ability.

1637-4423-5352.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional Islands.
You control at least three additional permanents that enter the battlefield untapped and can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}.
1637-4423-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {12}{G}{U}, creating four token copies of Mystic Sanctuary and three other permanents that enter the battlefield untapped and can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}.
When the tokens enter the battlefield untapped, each Mystic Sanctuary token triggers, and Aesi triggers for each land token that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Mystic Sanctuary triggers, putting Doppelgang on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve all Aesi triggers, causing you to Doppelgang, and optionally allowing you to draw a card for each remaining trigger.
Activate the four Mystic Sanctuary tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate ten of the other permanent tokens created in step 1 by tapping them, adding at least {9}{G}.
Repeat.

3086-3175-3556-4605.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Sun Titan, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sun Titan that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1494-2963-4802.notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has power 5 or greater.
1494-2963-4802.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

876-1003-4763-5147.description:
Equip Phyrexian Walker with Lightning Greaves.
Sacrifice Phyrexian Walker to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to you hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker.
Repeat.
